workflows.title: List hosts
workflows.summary: Hosts, quorum, votes, control node, and QDevice registration.
workflows.description: Reads cluster membership, quorum, and registry host slots through one reachable member, then checks SSH from this workstation to every host. Takes seconds.

params.label: Skip the SSH check from this workstation

workflows.title: List guests
workflows.summary: Production and staging VMs with live state, HA, replication, and routes.
workflows.description: Reads the BMAC registry and live Proxmox VM, HA, and replication state through one reachable member.

workflows.title: List replication jobs
workflows.summary: Every replication job's last sync, next sync, and failures.
workflows.description: Reads every online host's Proxmox replication status through one reachable member.

params.label: Production VM
params.help: Only show the jobs of this production VM.

workflows.title: List storage
workflows.summary: Every host's ZFS pool health and capacity and Proxmox storage.
workflows.description: Reads every online host's ZFS pools and Proxmox storage through one reachable member. Flags pools with less than 10% free.

workflows.title: List disks
workflows.summary: Every host's pool vdevs with LUKS state, and every disk outside a pool with its status.
workflows.description: Reads every online host directly over SSH: each pool vdev's state, encryption, and member disks with serial and size, and every disk outside a pool, whether it is available, awaiting retirement finalization, or part of an interrupted add or replace. Never finalizes anything; use Inventory disks for that.

workflows.title: Cluster health check
workflows.summary: Hosts, corosync links, QDevice, every ZFS member, free space, and SMART.
workflows.description: Inspects every host directly (or through another member), every corosync link between hosts, the QDevice, every ZFS pool and vdev member with disk serials, rpool free space, and each drive's SMART health. Guests are not inspected. Takes a minute or more.

workflows.title: Full cluster state
workflows.summary: Exhaustive read-only report of every host, the QDevice, and the registry.
workflows.description: Runs the complete read-only diagnostic snapshot on every reachable host and the QDevice: identity, networking, SSH trust, quorum, services, ISO readiness, HA, replication, ZFS, LUKS, SMART, boot, nftables, HAProxy, and the shared registry. Produces a very long report and takes several minutes.

workflows.title: Inspect a host
workflows.summary: One host's configuration, guests, replicas, and rpool layout with disk serials.
workflows.description: Shows one Proxmox host's configuration, the guests it runs and the replicas it stores, and its rpool layout: every vdev resolved to physical disk serials, the boot/ESP vdev, device-removal progress, unused disks, and per-zvol usage.

workflows.title: Inspect a production VM
workflows.summary: One production VM across HA, replication, routing, storage, QGA, and SSH.
workflows.description: Checks one registered production VM without changing guest, Proxmox, HA, replication, route, or registry configuration.

workflows.title: Inspect the QDevice
workflows.summary: Whether a QDevice is needed, registered, alive, and voting on every host.
workflows.description: Reports whether the cluster needs an external QDevice, whether one is registered, and whether every member sees it alive and voting, and explains how to repair or replace it.

workflows.title: Check QDevice access
workflows.summary: Whether this workstation reaches the prepared QDevice as root over SSH.
workflows.description: Checks that ssh root@PROXMOX_QDEVICE_HOST works from this workstation with strict host key checking. Needs no cluster member, so it works before the first Proxmox host is set up. Takes seconds.

workflows.title: Inventory disks
workflows.summary: Every physical disk, pool vdev, and disk that is safe to pull.
workflows.description: Inventories every physical disk on a host with serial and exact capacity, every pool vdev and member, and disks that are safe to remove. When a decommission has finished evacuating, it asks before finalizing the retirement of those disks.
workflows.notes: Normally read-only. It changes the host only if you approve finalizing a completed decommission.

workflows.title: Add production VM
workflows.summary: Allocate the next prodN, install its OS, replicate it, and enable HA.
workflows.description: Allocates the next prodN, installs its OS, verifies guest identity and SSH, creates replication to every selected placement host, configures HA, and publishes its routes. It can resume its own incomplete allocation after a failure. Start with a dry run.

workflows.title: Remove production VM
workflows.summary: Permanently destroy a production VM and everything BMAC owns for it.
workflows.description: Permanently removes one production VM after exact identity validation: routes, HA resource and rule, replication jobs and target copies, the VM and its volumes, orchestration metadata, and its registry allocation. Staging VMs derived from it must be removed first.

params.label: Dry run (show the destruction plan only)

workflows.title: Move production VM
workflows.summary: Relocate a production VM to another of its placement hosts.
workflows.description: Determines the VM's real HA owner, replicates the latest changes to the chosen placement host, and relocates the VM there. The application is briefly unavailable while the VM restarts. Staging VMs on the new owner are evicted.

workflows.title: Change placement
workflows.summary: Add or remove the hosts a production VM replicates to and may run on.
workflows.description: Adds placement hosts (replicating the VM there before HA may use them) or removes them (never the live owner, keeping at least two). Detects and finishes a partial earlier change.

workflows.title: Grow production disk
workflows.summary: Grow a production VM's root disk online.
workflows.description: Calculates how much the VM's root zvol may grow while every placement pool keeps 10% free, grows it on the live owner, replicates the new size, and grows the guest's filesystem online.

params.label: Dry run (show the growth limit only)

workflows.title: Set up SSH access
workflows.summary: Pin a guest's host key and configure ssh <alias> through a jump host.
workflows.description: Reads the guest's SSH host key through the guest agent, picks a jump host, writes a strict managed block to ~/.ssh/config and known_hosts, and proves ssh works.

workflows.title: Deploy example app
workflows.summary: Install the example NGINX hello app on a production VM.
workflows.description: Checks SSH to a production VM, installs or updates NGINX, and configures the production and staging hostnames with your Cloudflare origin certificate. An example deployment, not a general deployer.

workflows.title: Add staging VM
workflows.summary: Create a production-derived linked-clone staging VM.
workflows.description: Snapshots a production VM, waits for the snapshot to replicate to a standby host, and creates a stopped stageNprodN linked clone there with a new machine identity. Optionally starts it and sets up SSH. Start with a dry run.

params.label: Sanitizer script
params.help: Optional local Bash script run as root inside the clone before its networking starts.

workflows.title: Remove staging VM
workflows.summary: Destroy a staging VM, its clone, and its source snapshot.
workflows.description: Permanently removes a staging VM's route, VM and disks, linked clone, and the one source snapshot created for it. Production itself is never touched.

params.label: Dry run (show the destruction plan only)

workflows.title: Add Proxmox host
workflows.summary: Install and join a new Proxmox host using a customized installer ISO.
workflows.description: Builds a customized Proxmox installer ISO, guides the installation, converts storage, joins the host to the cluster through the control node, and reconciles the QDevice. Long-running and interactive.
workflows.platform_note: Requires a Debian-based Linux x86_64 workstation, because BMAC must build a customized Proxmox installer ISO with Proxmox's amd64-only Debian tool.

choices.label: Run mirror-member and final boot tests

workflows.title: Remove Proxmox host
workflows.summary: Remove a host gracefully, or forcefully when it is permanently dead.
workflows.description: Removes a host gracefully when it can be contacted and nothing depends on it, or forcefully when it cannot be contacted and has been permanently disconnected. Forced removal narrows affected production placement and destroys related staging VMs.
workflows.platform_note: Takes the same workstation flock as host setup, so it runs on Linux workstations only.

workflows.title: Update cluster runtime
workflows.summary: Deploy this checkout's BMAC runtime helpers and hooks to every host.
workflows.description: Stages and validates the BMAC runtime bundle on every online host, installs it atomically, verifies it cluster-wide, and rolls back on failure. Updates BMAC code only, not Proxmox packages.

workflows.title: Add mirrored vdev
workflows.summary: Add two new disks to a host's rpool as one mirror.
workflows.description: Lists unused disks, asks for two of matching capacity, prepares them (with LUKS at the host console on encrypted hosts), updates crypttab and initramfs, and adds them to rpool. Erases the chosen disks.

workflows.title: Replace mirror member
workflows.summary: Put a replacement disk into a degraded rpool mirror.
workflows.description: Copies the surviving member's partition layout to a replacement disk (and its ESP for the boot mirror), encrypts it on encrypted hosts, and starts resilvering. The failed disk must already be pulled.

workflows.title: Decommission a vdev
workflows.summary: Trim, replicate, scrub, then evacuate one non-boot vdev from rpool.
workflows.description: Requires that no related staging VM exists, trims affected production guests, forces their replication, scrubs rpool, and starts removing one eligible non-boot vdev. Finish with Inventory disks.

workflows.title: Simulate disk failure
workflows.summary: TEST AID: fail and erase one rpool mirror member.
workflows.description: Takes one member of a healthy two-way mirror offline and, after a second confirmation, erases its disk so the replacement workflow can be tested. Destroys the data on that disk.

workflows.title: Add QDevice
workflows.summary: Add an external tie-breaking vote to an even-sized cluster.
workflows.description: Checks that the cluster needs a QDevice, verifies SSH to the prepared QDevice machine, installs corosync-qnetd there, pins its host key on every host, and runs pvecm qdevice setup.
workflows.platform_note: Takes the same workstation flock as host setup, so it runs on Linux workstations only.

workflows.title: Remove QDevice
workflows.summary: Remove the QDevice gracefully, or evict a failed one forcefully.
workflows.description: Removes a reachable QDevice gracefully and uninstalls its software. When it is inaccessible, offers to evict it forcefully without contacting it, after you confirm it was removed from Tailscale.
workflows.platform_note: Takes the same workstation flock as host setup, so it runs on Linux workstations only.
